description: FAIRiCUBE republishes a Vienna imperviousness-density layer for the 2018 reference year. The provider says it reprojected the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service Imperviousness 2018 product to EPSG:31256 and gives sealing density from zero to 100 percent. Zenodo lists one public 100-metre GeoTIFF under CC BY 4.0. This cell-level share can inform runoff generation in stormwater simulations or identify heat-exposed sealed public space. It does not describe drains, infiltration rates or pavement material, so a hydraulic model needs additional inputs. The deposited copy has its own DOI and city extraction, while the underlying CLMS source has separate provenance and rights that should be checked before redistribution. No related catalogue record explicitly names this Vienna extraction. The GeoTIFF was not downloaded; the claimed CRS, values and reprojection quality remain unverified from file contents.
name: Vienna imperviousness density (2018)
